title: chaenomeles × superba f. perfecta
intro: Chaenomeles × superba f. perfecta, commonly known as the flowering quince 'Perfecta', is a hybrid shrub species derived from the cross between Chaenomeles speciosa and Chaenomeles japonica. This plant is known for its beautiful, fragrant flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Chaenomeles × superba f. perfecta include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of respiratory and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoid saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
